entities.name: GNN-based Retriever
entities.description: A retrieval method that encodes graph data and scores retrieval granularities based on similarity to the query.

entities.name: GNN-RAG
entities.description: A GNN-based retriever that encodes the graph, assigns scores to entities, and retrieves relevant entities based on a threshold.

entities.name: EtD
entities.description: A GNN-based retriever that iterates multiple times to retrieve relevant paths using LLaMA2 for edge selection and GNNs for node embeddings.

entities.name: LLaMA2
entities.description: A large language model used by EtD to select edges connecting the current node.

entities.name: RoG
entities.description: A hybrid retrieval method that utilizes LLMs to generate planning paths and then extracts paths from knowledge graphs.

entities.name: GenTKGQA
entities.description: A hybrid retrieval method that infers relations and constraints from queries using LLMs and extracts triplets accordingly.

entities.name: Multi-stage retrieval strategy
entities.description: A procedural strategy employing different models at each stage to improve retrieval efficiency and accuracy.

entities.name: Hybrid retrieval
entities.description: An approach combining non-parametric and parametric retrievers to balance efficiency and accuracy.

relationships.description: EtD uses LLaMA2 to select edges during its iterative retrieval process.
RoG adopts a multi-stage retrieval strategy, first using LLMs for planning and then extracting paths.
GenTKGQA adopts a multi-stage retrieval strategy, inferring constraints with LLMs and then extracting triplets.
GNN-RAG is an example of a GNN-based Retriever.
EtD is an example of a GNN-based Retriever.
